gramlot-js-server 0.2.2 renames the exporter. `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` has no code changes; its version follows the repository. Both packages require the core `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.1 or later.

## Changes

- `@gramlot/gramlot-browser` is now `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`: command `gramlot-serverless`, folder `serverless/`. The entry points are the same (`.`, `/directory`, `/standalone`, `/worker-host`).
- `@gramlot/gramlot-browser` is deprecated on npm and receives no new versions. There is no alias.

```sh
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-js-server
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-serverless
```

## Verified

Node.js 22 and 23.11, Bun 1.3.14, Chromium 153; the core 0.2.0 qualification covers WebKit 26.6 and Firefox 155. WebKit is not Safari; Safari is not verified.
